hook_text: The captain lifted the trophy. But the captain did not win the match alone.
clip_script: Rustenburg. The netball team is losing at half-time. Their captain, Naledi, does not shout. She gets everyone in a circle, asks the defenders what they need, and gives every player a job. They win. That is teamwork. Siya Kolisi led the Springboks to win the Rugby World Cup by making every player feel part of one team. Helen Suzman stood up alone in Parliament for thirteen years to speak against unfair laws. That is courage. A good leader works with a team and is brave.
visual_style: Whiteboard netball court with players linked by lines into one team, then a single figure standing tall in a big hall full of empty chairs.
mood: Energetic and inspiring, like a halftime team talk.
pacing: Team huddle, then a trophy, then one brave voice in a big room.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and think of a time you were brave for someone else.
